daily_summary: Pfizer partners with Innovent Biologics for oncology programs. - FDA approves companion diagnostics for Pfizer's TALZENNA. - Pfizer to webcast discussion at Goldman Sachs Healthcare Conference. - Pfizer oncology deal includes antibody drug conjugates. - Pfizer's LORBRENA shows sustained protection in lung cancer trial.
Pfizer CEO discusses obesity drug pipeline. - Pfizer targets 2026 with obesity, oncology studies. - Pfizer and Innovent Biologics announce oncology collaboration.
Pfizer presents positive Phase 3 trial results at ASCO 2026. - Pfizer to present at Jefferies Global Healthcare Conference 2026.
Pfizer inks AI deal with Chai Discovery for drug discovery. - Generic version of Pfizer's Xeljanz launched by Breckenridge. - Pfizer uses Chai Discovery AI to expand biologics pipeline.
